title: "Replication packages in AEA journals"
subtitle: "Coverage over time, time from submission to publication, and the 2019 AEA data and code policy"

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
shareRaw = FileAttachment("data/share_by_journal_year.csv").csv({typed: true})
shareAll = shareRaw.filter(d => d.Journal === "Main journals")
policyLines = [{year: 2005, label: "2005: AER policy"}, {year: 2009, label: "2009: AEJs"},
               {year: 2019, label: "2019: AEA-wide"}]
Plot.plot({
  title: "Research articles in the AER, AER:Insights and AEJs, and articles with a replication package, by year",
  width, height: 400, marginLeft: 50,
  x: {label: null, tickFormat: "d"},
  y: {label: "Articles", grid: true},
  color: {legend: true, domain: ["All research articles", "With a replication package"],
          range: ["#c8c8c8", "#1B4F8A"]},
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(shareAll, {x1: d => d.year - 0.42, x2: d => d.year + 0.42, y: "articles",
                          fill: () => "All research articles"}),
    Plot.rectY(shareAll, {x1: d => d.year - 0.27, x2: d => d.year + 0.27, y: "with_package",
                          fill: () => "With a replication package"}),
    Plot.ruleX(policyLines, {x: d => d.year - 0.5, stroke: "#44546A", strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
    Plot.text(policyLines, {x: d => d.year - 0.5, frameAnchor: "top", text: "label", textAnchor: "start",
                            dx: 3, dy: 4, fill: "#44546A", fontSize: 10}),
    Plot.tip(shareAll, Plot.pointerX({x: "year", y: "articles",
      title: d => `${d.year}\n${d.articles} research articles\n${d.with_package} with a package (${(100 * d.share).toFixed(0)}%)`})),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```

```{r}
suppressMessages({library(readr); library(dplyr)})
all  <- read_csv("data/share_by_journal_year.csv", show_col_types=FALSE) %>% filter(Journal=="Main journals")
last <- max(all$year)
pct  <- function(x) paste0(round(100*x), "%")
```

This site tracks the research articles published in the journals of the American Economic Association (AEA) since 1999. It shows how many have a replication package in the [AEA Data and Code Repository](https://www.openicpsr.org/openicpsr/aea) at openICPSR. The main analysis covers the AER, AER:Insights and the four AEJs. The AEA Papers and Proceedings, the JEL and the JEP are reported separately on the [Appendix](appendix.qmd) page. Comments, replies and errata are not counted as research articles.

- In `r last`, `r pct(all$share[all$year==last])` of the `r all$articles[all$year==last]` research articles in the AER, AER:Insights and AEJs had a replication package. In 1999 (AER only), `r pct(all$share[all$year==1999])` did.
- The AER introduced a data policy in 2005. The AEJs had one from their launch in 2009. The AEA-wide policy, with review by the AEA Data Editor, took effect in 2019.

## Pages

- **[Packages](packages.qmd)**: share and number of articles with a replication package, by journal and year.
- **[Time from submission to publication](time-to-publication.qmd)**: months from submission to print publication, by journal: before and after 2019, and for articles with and without a replication package.
- **[Policy regressions](regressions.qmd)**: did the 2019 policy change the presence of packages or the time from submission to publication? Event studies by year of publication, with static before/after regressions at the actual and placebo implementation years as robustness.
- **[Appendix](appendix.qmd)**: the AEA P&P, JEL and JEP: packages over time, and the policy regressions, including the difference in differences that uses them as newly covered journals.
- **[Methods](methods.qmd)**: all tables, the regression equations, and how articles, packages, and submission dates are identified.
- **[Data](data.qmd)**: the full article-level dataset, with the flags used in the analysis and the DOIs of articles and replication packages. Searchable and downloadable.
